Added OpenAPI contract coverage for PUT /v1/cloud/iam/identity-providers/{identity_provider_id} plus update request and success response schemas.
Updated M03-P01/IP-004 status as provider-managed IdP create/list/update API green while preserving delete, provider runtime adapter/sync status, and live-smoke gaps.

notes: The update API is a write path and requires Idempotency-Key with replay protected by a canonical request fingerprint.

Tenant isolation is enforced before domain mutation by matching header tenant, authenticated principal tenant, and body tenant_id; the domain also rejects updates against an existing provider owned by another tenant.
The domain update preserves created_at_epoch_seconds to avoid turning lifecycle creation time into mutable input.
The ChangeSet explicitly does not claim IdP delete, provider sync, or live smoke completion.
GitHub auto-merge remains gated after oya-pr-review/checks; no manual merge is required before moving to the next PR once auto-merge is enabled.

known_gaps.reason: This ChangeSet adds update only; delete is a separately reviewable IdP lifecycle surface.
No provider adapter, provider SDK, cloud account mutation, or runtime sync status path was introduced.
No live cloud or self-hosted IdP endpoint was contacted; this is deterministic API contract/runtime evidence only.
